svg.title: A selected route through a switching matrix and records linked by a shared key
A connection, located
svg.desc: Three inputs meet three outputs on a regular switching grid. A single closed junction connects B to 02, turning an abstract matrix into a precise route.

svg.title: Supabase · A shared relation
